title: Children's Hooded Jackets with Drawstrings Recalled by Jason Evans Associates Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 1,300.

title: Commercial Freezers Used in Grocery Stores Recalled By Unilever Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The controller of the freezer is incompatible with the unit and can overheat and melt the relay, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 960.

title: Off-Road Motorcycles Recalled by KTM North America Due to Front Fork Failure
summary: The front fork inner tube on the off-road motorcycles can crack and separate from the fork axle, posing a risk of injury or death to the operator. Units: About 550.

title: Children’s Jewelry Craft Kits Recalled by Action Products International Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The lobster clasps in both craft kits contain high levels of lead. The Abalone Necklace's pendant also contains high levels of lead. Lead can be toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 2,900 in the United States and 36 in Canada.

title: Richard Abraham Herder KG Recalls Torque Wrenches Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The internal spring mechanism on the wrench can fail or break, allowing bolts or screws to break or become unscrewed, posing a risk of injury to the user or bystander. Units: About 670.

title: Ambler Mountain Works Recalls Children's Knitted Hats Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The eyeballs on the Erwin Beanie and the octopus legs on the Poseidon Beanie can come loose, posing a potential choking hazard. Units: About 370.

title: Wagner Spray Tech Recalls Paint Sprayers Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The on-off switch can be dislodged from the casing, resulting in exposure of electrical connections. This can pose an electrical shock hazard to the consumer. Units: About 35,000.

title: Samsung Recalls to Upgrade Certain Cell Phones; Could Fail to Reach Emergency 911 in a No-Service Area
summary: The recalled cell phones that are in a no-service area and display an "out of range, try again later" message could fail to connect to emergency 911. Units: About 160,000.

title: Bunn-O-Matic Recalls Single Cup Tea/Coffeemakers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The pod drawer of the pod brewer can open unexpectedly during a brew cycle, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 35,600.

title: Girl's Hooded Sweatshirts Recalled by Ely and Walker Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 580.

title: Gothic Cabinet Craft Recalls Bunk Beds Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bunk beds do not have sufficient headboards, footboards, or guardrails and have gaps between parts of the upper bunk that could allow a child's body to pass through but not a child's head. title: Ross Stores Recalls Benches Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bench frame can collapse when weight is placed on it, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 225.

title: Cannondale Recalls Bicycles; JD Forks Can Lose Alignment, Posing Crash Hazard
summary: The recalled bicycle's fork can lose alignment causing the front wheel to turn unexpectedly. This can cause the rider to lose control of the bicycle and crash. Units: About 1,500.

title: Norco Recalls Bicycle Frames Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The bicycle frame can crack and separate, causing a rider to fall from the bicycle and suffer injuries. Units: About 3,600.

title: Trek Recalls Bicycles; JD Forks Can Lose Alignment, Posing Crash Hazard
summary: The recalled bicycle's fork can lose alignment causing the front wheel to turn unexpectedly. This can cause the rider to lose control of the bicycle and crash. Units: About 16,000.

title: Digital Clamp Meters Recalled by Fluke Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The meters can fail to give an appropriate voltage reading, resulting in the operator falsely believing the electrical power is off, posing a shock, electrocution, or thermal burn hazard. Units: About 52,000.

title: Folding Toy Beach Chairs Recalled by Build-A-Bear Workshop Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: This toy chair legs can bruise, pinch or cut fingers if caught while folding. Units: About 260,000 chairs in the United States and 9,700 in Canada.

title: HP Recalls Notebook Computer Batteries Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 70,000.

title: Browning and Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation Recall Knife Sheaths Due to Defect
summary: The knife can cut through the sheath because there is no blade guard in the sheath. This poses a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

title: Composite Decks Recalled by Louisiana-Pacific; Decks Can Deteriorate and Break, Posing Fall Hazard
summary: The recalled decking can prematurely deteriorate and unexpectedly break. Consumers can fall through broken decking and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 48 million linear feet (decks vary in size).

title: Engine Block and Battery Heaters Used on Polaris Snowmobiles Recalled Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The insulation of the electrical cord for the engine and battery heaters can fail during cold temperatures, posing an electric shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 650.

title: Fushin USA Recalls Youth Model ATVs Due to Risk of Injury to Young Riders
summary: These ATVs lack front brakes, a tire pressure gauge, and padding to cover the sharp edges on the handlebar assembly, which could pose a risk of injury to young riders. Units: About 650.

title: Dahon and REI Novara Folding Bicycles Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The hinge on the handlepost can crack, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 11,500.

title: Lumetique Recalls Botanika Candles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The glass can break during use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 7,000.

title: Home Depot Recalls Patio Umbrellas Due to Risk of Impact Injury
summary: The patio umbrella and its pole could tip over and strike consumers if the umbrella's collar or sleeve is not removed prior to closing the umbrella, posing a risk of impact injury to consumers. Units: About 60.

title: Outdoor Play Sets Sold Exclusively at Toys"R"Us Recalled by Step2 Due to Fall Hazard; Swings Can Break
summary: The triangular hangers that attach the swing's ropes to the upper rail of the play set can break, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 4,300.

title: Trampolines Recalled by Skywalker Holdings; Enclosure Problems Can Result in Fall Hazard
summary: The straps supporting the top of the trampoline's enclosure to the poles can fail. The enclosure could drop if these straps break, posing a risk that a user could fall from the trampoline. Units: About 60,000.
